compile.nuance: Question text self-labels these as 'non-regulatory customary disclosures.' Only 1 of 3 defect options (O-BP-54652, Borrower Certification and Authorization to Release Information) has a plausible Guide analog (B1-1-02, Blanket Authorization Form -- a differently-named lender form serving the same borrower-authorization purpose, not verified as the identical document). O-BP-54653 (Flood Insurance Subject to Change disclosure) and O-BP-54654 (Intent to Proceed with Application) are TRID/RESPA/Reg Z-driven disclosures with no Selling Guide equivalent found via exhaustive grep of guide/sections/ ('Borrower Certification and Authorization', 'Intent to Proceed', 'Flood Insurance Subject to Change', 'Special Flood Hazard' disclosure timing). Card kept its 1 partial citation rather than dropping to zero, but is flagged lender_specific_no_guide_basis because the card's core subject is lender-ops/compliance-form practice, not a Selling Guide requirement.
